page.layout: One column of verse under a full-width title; the drop-cap S starts the first line. Below the poem, at the right, a signature "L. y." Ornamental headpiece above the title. No marginal notes. Page number top right.

main_text.head: TH. BEZA, IN ANNVM suum Climactericum decimum exactum.

p.i: Septenos decies transfegi, mi Deus, annos, Quos dum seco in minutias, Et recti ad normam tam longa tempora vitæ, Vt factum oportet, exigo: Heu, delictorum numerum pondusque meorum Inire nec ego sum potis, Quem si forte ineas, vah, quanto optatius esset Non esse natum, aut mox mori? Finitum tamen est deliqui, Maxime, quicquid, Numerare quanuis nesciam. Horrenda sedenim pœnas, guttaque cruoris, Quas ille fudit innocens, Seruandis natus miseris, & crimina fassis, Numero carent & pondere. Spes igitur miserum fouet hæc me sola, futurum (Sperare vt ipse me iubes) Innumera luerint numerosa vt crimina pœnas, Soluta nec, Deus, exigas.

page.notes: The drop cap is an ornamental S; the word is "Septenos". The signature "L. ỵ." uses a y-like sign, read as "y" with [?] not added since it is a conventional mark. The faint mirrored text in the margins and at the top is show-through and was left out. The running head is not legible and was not transcribed.
